Data Analyst (Working Student) - Munich, Germany

Acme Analytics GmbH is looking for a motivated Working Student Data Analyst
to join our growing analytics team in Munich.

Your profile:
- You are currently enrolled at a university in a quantitative field.
- Strong SQL skills are required.
- Experience with Python (pandas) is required.
- Familiarity with Power BI is required.
- Fluent German (C1) and English are required.

Nice to have:
- Experience with dbt is a plus.
- Knowledge of AWS is ideally present, but not required.

What you'll do:
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI.
- Write SQL queries against our data warehouse.
- Support the team with ad-hoc analyses in Python.

We offer flexible working hours, a modern office in central Munich, and a
JobRad bike leasing program.
